svg.title: Where the 8,976 bytes go
svg.desc: A standalone certificate of 8,976 bytes: 4 bytes of outer header, 1,495 bytes of TBSCertificate (1,334 of them the public key), 12 bytes of algorithm identifier, and a 7,465-byte signatureValue holding the MTCProof. The MTCProof is 2 bytes of extensions, 12 bytes of start and end, 162 bytes of inclusion proof (5 hashes), 3 bytes of length, and 7,281 bytes of three cosignatures from the CA and two witnesses. A landmark-relative certificate keeps the TBSCertificate and replaces the 7,465 bytes with 344.

text.tspan: ext, start, end, 5 proof hashes, length: 179 bytes
each cosignature: ID length 1 + ID 4 + length 2 + ML-DSA-44 2,420
the Merkle part costs 179 bytes. The signatures cost 7,281.
landmark-relative: same TBSCertificate, and an MTCProof of 339 bytes (10 hashes, no signatures).
total 1,855 bytes, and most of it is the subscriber's own public key.
